status: design review only; unresolved findings documented in review-notes.md

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Total reports", "Unassigned", "In progress", "Resolved").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "info" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "assessment" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "manage_accounts" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Supplier portal" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (IBM Plex Sans, Material Symbols Outlined, ui-monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most.

findings.message: Placeholder data on screen: example.com.
findings.fix: Use believable data for this product: real-looking names, amounts that add up, dates in order, units on every figure.

findings.message: 72% of the text is under 13px.
findings.fix: Data and labels read at 13–14px; keep 11–12px for sublines and axis ticks.

findings.message: 7 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Report triage, customer messag" (5px from the right); "Unassigned" (9px from the right); "24 Oct" (4px from the right); "Issue breakdown" (-1px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 1 pair(s) of cards in one row end at different heights (by 420px).
findings.fix: Cards that share a row share a bottom edge: balance them by their content (the same number of rows, a block of similar height beside it), or stack them. In testing, ragged rows were marked down every time.

findings.message: The sidebar still takes 40% of the width on a 390px phone.
findings.fix: On a phone the navigation folds into a top bar with a menu button or a bottom bar of four or five destinations; the screen's content gets the full width.
